report_name: Draft Ipswich Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan (LCWIP)
how_pct_was_used: The Propensity to Cycle Tool was used to demonstrate cycling desire lines for journeys to work and school, and to assess potential cycling rates under different scenarios to assist in identifying new schemes.
other_tools_developed: Multi Criteria Assessment Framework (MCAF) and Walking Route Audit Tool (WRAT)
specific_evidence_of_impact: The document states that the LCWIP is a strategic approach to identify improvements and that having a prioritised list of routes 'ready to go' will place Ipswich and Suffolk in a stronger position to bid for and secure delivery funding when opportunities arise.
